# Sugarcoat

[![Sugarcoat (right) with Sunny Flare — Dance Magic, Hasbro Studios/DHX Media](https://cdn.twibooru.org/img/2020/7/18/1151036/medium.png)](https://twibooru.org/1151036)

Sugarcoat is Crystal Prep Academy’s brutally honest Shadowbolt: think Applejack’s honesty without her tact. Recognize her by her lavender-blue skin, violet eyes, orange rectangular glasses, icy-white twin ponytails, pink hair clips and burgundy plaid school uniform.

- **Name:** Official, not fan-created. Hasbro’s July 2015 promotional biography explicitly contrasts her bluntness with Applejack’s honesty ([archived promotional biography](https://www.mlpmerch.com/2015/07/equestria-girls-website-get-friendship-games-update.html)).
- **Voice:** Speaking character, voiced in English by Sienna Bohn ([film cast and dialogue](https://www.imdb.com/title/tt4450396/characters/nm3703274/)).
- **Continuity and appearances:** An official human character in Equestria Girls. Debuts in Friendship Games (2015), returns in Dance Magic (2017, first of three specials), and briefly appears in the music video replay in Mirror Magic (2017, third special). No verified pony-world counterpart or alternate identity ([character reference](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Sugarcoat)).

[![Sugarcoat chibi — artwork by emera33](https://cdn.twibooru.org/img/2020/7/14/798856/medium.png)](https://twibooru.org/798856)

## Important moments

- **A painfully honest introduction — Friendship Games (2015 film):** She immediately criticizes Twilight’s awkward speech, establishing her lack of tact ([film transcript](https://equestriagirls.fandom.com/wiki/Transcripts/My_Little_Pony_Equestria_Girls%3A_Friendship_Games); timestamp unavailable).
- **Calling out Principal Cinch — Friendship Games:** After helping pressure Twilight earlier, Sugarcoat openly exposes Cinch’s manipulation when the principal demands a forfeit ([scene clip](https://clip.cafe/my-little-pony-equestria-girls-friendship-games-2015/principal-celestia/); clip begins at approximately 1:05:35 in the film according to the host).
- **Logic over rivalry — Dance Magic (2017 special 1):** She endorses combining the rival teams’ talents and helps settle a rehearsal disagreement, contributing to their winning Crystal Rainbooms performance ([special transcript](https://equestriagirls.fandom.com/wiki/Transcripts/My_Little_Pony_Equestria_Girls%3A_Dance_Magic); [official full special](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qegP3I6F0cI), timestamp unavailable).
